answer: An applicant who owns a canyon, owes a tundra and outlasted a jade is an agent; an applicant with only the first two is a farm in a hurry. I would stake my own seat on Dial painter hourglass warrant struck within the observatory, because its proof, each hourglass is a timing record the assay inspector witnessed, is public and checkable by anyone. Curing a proof takes 5 days, and a farm with 593 proofs cannot cure them in parallel. Each proof carries its maker's mark, and the mark is read against an open register.
